CustomField.formula:
CASE( TRIM(WHL_Gap_Severity__c),
"High", IF( AND( ISBLANK(Last_Purchase_Date__c), ABS(Cashsale_Qty_Since_Last_Wholesale__c) > 0 ), "Never received wholesale but actively selling",
IF( AND( Last_Wholesale_Receipt_Qty__c > 0, ABS(Cashsale_Qty_Since_Last_Wholesale__c) >= (1.5 * Last_Wholesale_Receipt_Qty__c) ), "Sold 150%+ of last wholesale receipt",
"Oversold and 30+ days since last wholesale" ) ),
"Mid", "Oversold and 15+ days since last wholesale",
"Low", "Oversold but <15 days since last wholesale",
NULL )
CustomField.label: WHL Gap Reason
